_note: The models offered for Impulse 0.1.1 on first run and in Deploy your own. Only models verified with Impulse (its docs/RUN.md, docs/BUILD.md, docs/LFM25.md, docs/QWEN36.md). Edit here; the order is the order shown. needs: a NVIDIA card with at least gpu_mb of memory, ram_mb of system RAM (Impulse keeps the experts in RAM, a cache of them on the card), disk_mb free. friends: offered on a friend's path (joining by an invite); the owner sees every model. recommend: the order in which one model is recommended (the first that fits this computer).

models.name: LFM2.5 24B
models.about: Quick and light: answers fast on a 8 GB card. Text only.
models.verified: impulse/docs/LFM25.md (the official checkpoint; its hash in impulse/profiles/lfm25-qad-q4_0.json)

models.name: Gemma 4 26B
models.about: The all-rounder: thoughtful answers, reads pictures, fast with its drafter. Needs a 12 GB card.
models.verified: impulse/docs/BUILD.md and docs/RUN.md (the model, its MTP drafter and its projector)

standard.source: Google's own QAT Q4_0; the MTP head is gemma-4-26B-A4B-it's

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B
models.about: The biggest: strongest at code and long documents, reads pictures. Needs a 16 GB card and plenty of RAM.
models.verified: impulse/docs/BUILD.md and docs/QWEN36.md (the model and its projector; its MTP drafter is read out of another file with a tool, so it runs here without one)
